description: Explore the proven experience and leadership that make Audrey P. Willis the right choice for Arkansas State Representative, District 35. From serving as Chief Innovation and Strategy Officer at CodeCrew to roles in government and technology, Audrey has built a career focused on education, workforce development, and community empowerment. Her qualifications reflect a lifelong commitment to service, innovation, and driving opportunity across West Memphis, Marion, Earle, Parkin, and Turrell.
title: QUALIFICATIONS | Audrey for Arkansas District 35
